title: Erased
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Satoru Fujinuma, a 29-year-old struggling manga artist, has 'Revival', which throws him back moments before a disaster. When his mother is murdered, he is sent back to 1988 as an 11-year-old in Hokkaido, where he works to save her and to stop a serial killer targeting his classmates, including Kayo, who is beaten at home. The killer is his teacher Yashiro, who nearly drowns him; Satoru wakes from a 15-year coma and finally confronts him.
life_message: It holds up courage to protect the vulnerable and loyal friendship that refuses to give up on others.
